intent: Admit the minimum Titanium-owned API composition seam for an exact-path, read-only SADHANA supervisor JSON provider. The provider makes a bounded nested MissionSnapshot available to the existing injected control-surface contract without opening either canonical database, following symlinks, claiming writer liveness, or enabling the generic runtime graph/event database routes.

commit.message: governance: admit SADHANA immutable read model

interface_mismatches: The existing control-surface mission endpoint has an injected-provider contract, but api/main.py injects no provider and therefore truthfully returns uninitialized.
The supervisor publishes one atomically replaced campaign JSON read model containing a nested MissionSnapshot, while the API must not open its TaskBoard or RuntimeStateStore databases.

The dashboard's existing generic runtime query uses mission:<id>, but Orchestrator owner runs are required to use a distinct owner session; those reads are both unsafe and unable to prove the owner join.
honest_blockers: This admission changes no API code, starts no service, reads no projection, opens no network route, and proves no mission, process, agent, model, or acceptance state.
The implementation is bound to the final supervisor projection schema and producer content-digest formula; it must fail closed while either is absent or unsupported.
A fresh secure JSON projection proves an observed read model under file custody, not a live writer, useful work, semantic correctness, independent acceptance, or campaign completion.
Owner-execution topology requires a separate organism-owned bounded projection contract; this Titanium packet must leave generic runtime graph/event readiness unavailable.
session_entry.rollback: Revert this admission and its deterministic generated mirrors. No API process, file reader, canonical database, task, runtime receipt, dashboard, network listener, or external system is changed by admission rollback.
